parameters.query:
-- Router: create a case for every new email, check the sender, find the route.
-- Uses temp tables; they are dropped at the end.

-- 0. Create a case for every bronze email that has none yet
INSERT INTO silver.command (case_id, gmail_id, thread_id)
SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(b.gmail_id, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), b.gmail_id, b.thread_id
FROM bronze.gmail_message b
LEFT JOIN silver.command c ON c.gmail_id = b.gmail_id
WHERE c.gmail_id IS NULL
ON CONFLICT (case_id) DO NOTHING;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS pg_temp.tmp_lookup, pg_temp.tmp_src, pg_temp.tmp_resolved;

-- 1. Every word that names a route: the route name itself and its aliases
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_lookup AS
SELECT lower(route) AS word, route
FROM ctl.route
WHERE enabled
UNION
SELECT a.alias, a.route
FROM ctl.route_alias a
JOIN ctl.route r ON r.route = a.route
WHERE r.enabled;

-- 2. New cases with the three fields the router needs
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_src AS
SELECT c.case_id,
       lower(b.message->'from'->'value'->0->>'address') AS sender,
       substring(lower(b.message->'to'->'value'->0->>'address') from '\+([^@]+)@') AS plus_word,
       lower((regexp_split_to_array(
                btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(b.message->>'subject', ''),
                                     '^\s*((re|fwd?|aw|wg)\s*:\s*)+', '', 'i')),
                '\s+'))[1]) AS subject_word
FROM silver.command c
JOIN bronze.gmail_message b ON b.gmail_id = c.gmail_id
WHERE c.status = 'received';

-- 3. Owner from the allow-list; route from plus-address, then subject word, then help
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_resolved AS
SELECT s.case_id,
       o.owner_id,
       coalesce(l1.route, l2.route, 'help') AS route,
       CASE WHEN l1.route IS NOT NULL THEN 'plus_address'
            WHEN l2.route IS NOT NULL THEN 'subject'
            ELSE 'fallback'
       END AS resolved_by
FROM tmp_src s
LEFT JOIN ctl.owner_address o ON o.address = s.sender
LEFT JOIN tmp_lookup l1 ON l1.word = s.plus_word
LEFT JOIN tmp_lookup l2 ON l2.word = s.subject_word;

-- 4. Write the result; unknown senders become 'failed' and get no route
UPDATE silver.command c
SET owner_id    = r.owner_id,
    route       = CASE WHEN r.owner_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE r.route END,
    resolved_by = CASE WHEN r.owner_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE r.resolved_by END,
    status      = CASE WHEN r.owner_id IS NULL THEN 'failed' ELSE 'routed' END,
    summary     = CASE WHEN r.owner_id IS NULL THEN 'sender not on the allow-list' END
FROM tmp_resolved r
WHERE c.case_id = r.case_id
RETURNING c.case_id, c.gmail_id, c.thread_id, c.owner_id, c.route, c.resolved_by, c.status;

DROP TABLE tmp_lookup, tmp_src, tmp_resolved;

SELECT '{{ $json.case_id }}'   AS case_id,
       '{{ $json.thread_id }}' AS thread_id,
       'Available commands:' || E'\n' ||
       string_agg('- ' || route || ': ' || description, E'\n' ORDER BY route) AS summary
FROM ctl.route
WHERE enabled;
